systems.country_label: national health management information system (HMIS); National Health Information System
systems.tiers: national; community-level data not yet integrated (2024)

note: No fact: the brief (UNICEF MENARO with the Ministry of Health, September 2024) states that Djibouti uses DHIS2 as its national HMIS, that community-level data has not been integrated although the system could hold it, and that there are no community indicators or tools for collecting community data; none of this gives a value for tiers, where data is digitised, clinics, governance of the HMIS or a dated event. No community health worker system is named; the planned medical secretaries collecting data electronically are a stated intention. Relevant to the community-integrated flag: not integrated as of 2024.
